## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change does what the description says, and nothing more
- [ ] Tests were added or updated and pass in CI
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] No leftover conflict markers, debug code, or secrets
- [ ] AI-generated analysis (if any) was treated as one input, not the verdict
- [ ] I could explain every changed line if asked
